jade-cs: Citrine Labs flagged a jump in unit cost and intermittent p99 tail spikes in eu-central over the past 3 days. Renewal call in ~2 weeks. Proposal: try a conservative int4 trial on low-risk stateless routes, route short replies (<80 tokens) to a smaller local model, and shift critical traffic to a tiny reserved EU pool during morning peak. Thoughts?

omar-se: int4 is bold but could be worth it for their high-volume webhook endpoints. We must run their exact prompt samples in staging first. Also add a tokenization sanity pass; we saw truncation edgecases last quarter.

tanya-ml: I can prepare a style-preserve quant profile: int4 for most layers, keep attention and norm layers at fp16, and preserve system prompts in fp16. Will run quality delta on their 180-sample eval set.

mike-ops: Canary routing sketch:
```json
{"policy":"route_by_priority","routes":[{"path":"/api/webhook","max_tokens":80,"model":"citrine-orca-small","weight":0.06,"pool":"eu-reserved"},{"path":"/api/webhook","model":"rw-13b-int4","weight":0.88,"pool":"shared-eu"}],"canary_duration_min":60}
```
Start 6:30 CET when their spike begins. Increase to 25% if stable.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: citrine.int4-canary -> eu-reserved at 1759991300 (6% for 1h). Monitors: p95_latency, p99_tail_latency, gen_quality_delta, cost_per_1k_tokens. Alerts to #customer-success if thresholds breach.

jade-cs: I'll request 180 representative non-sensitive prompts and permission for the trial. Proposed enablement demo Tue 08:00 CET (matches their morning window).

omar-se: Rollback criteria: auto-revert if p99 latency increases >15% or gen_quality_delta >1.0% absolute, or if any hallucination rate signal spikes >0.8%. Capture cost savings projection for the renewal deck.

tanya-ml: I'll deliver a short dashboard: baseline vs int4 vs small-model for short responses, plus 20 manual checks. ETA: 24h.

mike-ops: I'll wire tracing and token-level cost breakdowns to the enablement doc. If quality dips, route weight will automatically drop to 0% and route to fp16.

jade-cs: Owners: @tanya-ml eval, @omar-se deploy/rollback, @mike-ops routing/canary. I'll own customer comms and add notes to the renewal playbook. Thanks team :raised_hands:
